title: LectraAI Research — Artifact Rating Record
description: One record per (lecture, artifact_type, condition, item) rated by one reviewer. Used for Experiment B (artifact quality) and Experiment C (notes/prompt ablation). Reviewers see only the blinded condition_label ('System A'/'System B'), never the true condition, at rating time — see annotations/ratings/blinding_protocol.md.

item_id.description: e.g. a specific quiz question id — omit/null for a whole-document 'notes' rating.

condition_label.description: Blinded label. The true condition (e.g. 'deterministic' vs 'direct_llm', or 'constrained_prompt' vs 'unconstrained_prompt') is looked up ONLY after all ratings are collected, from a separate, reviewer-inaccessible mapping file.

scores.description: Only the dimensions relevant to artifact_type are populated (see rubric .md files in this directory) — do not force every dimension for every artifact type (Phase 4 §8).

answer_correctness_binary.description: Quiz/flashcard/interview only: is the marked/given answer actually correct per the source notes?

unsupported_claims.description: Notes/prompt-ablation only (Experiment C): each unsupported/ungrounded claim the reviewer identified, as a short quote from the generated text.

likert5.description: 1 = very poor, 2 = poor, 3 = acceptable, 4 = good, 5 = excellent (Phase 4 §8 fixed scale).
